transcript:
User: This is Frank. Whoever you people are, I want to know how you got this number.
Agent: Got it, Frank — sounds like that really rubbed you the wrong way.  

So I can explain it clearly, did you get a voicemail from us, an email, or did we show up as a missed call on your phone?
User: None of your damn business. Just tell me what you want without any of your scripted nonsense.
Agent: Understood, I’ll keep it straight.  

We’re a company that helps businesses stop losing money from missed phone calls — whoever called you was trying to see if that’s an issue for you.  

If you tell me the number we called or how we showed up, I can get you removed and make sure we don’t bother you again — want me to just take you off our list and be done with it?
User: You people are all liars and thieves. Just leave me alone, I’m not interested.
Agent: I hear you, Frank. I’ll make sure we don’t contact you again from our side. Thanks for picking up, and I’ll let you go now — take care.

chat_analysis.chat_summary: Frank contacted the agent upset about receiving a call and demanded to know how his number was obtained. The agent explained the company's purpose and offered to remove Frank from their contact list, which Frank requested. The agent confirmed Frank would not be contacted again and ended the call.
